tlv.description: Sent from range means the command has been transmitted to the spacecraft by the network that connects the ground system to the spacecraft. Obviously, this verifier must come from something other than the spacecraft. (Success: 1, Failure: 0, N/A: 255) (Default: 255)

Transferred to range means the command has been received to the network that connects the ground system to the spacecraft. Obviously, this verifier must come from something other than the spacecraft. (Success: 1, Failure: 0, N/A: 255) (Default: 255)
A verifier that simply means the SpaceSystem has received the command. (Success: 1, Failure: 0, N/A: 255) (Default: 255)
A verifier that means the SpaceSystem has accepted the command. (Success: 1, Failure: 0, N/A: 255) (Default: 255)
A verifer that means the command is scheduled for execution by the SpaceSystem. (Success: 1, Failure: 0, N/A: 255) (Default: 255)

A verifier that indicates that the command is being executed. An optional Element indicates how far along the command has progressed either as a fixed value or an (possibly scaled) ParameterInstance value. (Success: 1, Failure: 0, N/A: 255) (Default: 255)
A possible set of verifiers that all must be true for the command be considered completed. (Success: 1, Failure: 0, N/A: 255) (Default: 255)
When true, indicates that the command failed. timeToWait is how long to wait for the FailedVerifier to test true. (Failure: 1, Success: 0, N/A: 255) (Default: 255)
Timestamp for the raw data representing the number of non-leap seconds that have elapsed since 00:00:00 UTC on 1 January 1970. (Default: 0)
The number of picoseconds representing the fractional portion of the 'Timestamp Seconds' metadata. (Default: 0)
Directive Response (Success: 1, Failure: 0, In Progress (Keep-Alive) / N/A: 255) (Default: 255)
Command Phase name (e.g., post-encryption, post-encoding) associated with updated command bits (payload) (Default: )
